name: Campaign
description: Paid, organic, event, and launch creative that remains recognisably Wonka at multiple aspect ratios.

constraints.value: Render logos, copy, prices, CTAs, and legal text deterministically after any generative background step.
Claims and offer terms require explicit human approval before publication.
Preserve hierarchy and safe zones when adapting 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, and 16:9 formats.
Use the signal-cut geometry once as the expressive brand gesture; avoid generic decorative gradients.

provenance.source: Wonka Brand DNA and AI Creative Studio contracts
